builds.name: DK Standard Fiend
builds.description: The bread-and-butter Undead build. Death Knight opener into fast Crypt Fiend production, Lich second for Frost Nova. Works in every matchup with adjustments.
strategyPoints: Open DK for Unholy Aura speed and Death Coil sustain — creep efficiently to level 3
Rush to tier 2 around 5:30–6:00, start Fiend production immediately from Crypt
Lich second hero with Frost Nova — obliterates clumped melee and provides burst damage
Add Obsidian Statues at T2 for mana/HP regen sustain in prolonged fights
T3 for Orb of Corruption on DK — armor debuff makes Fiend focus fire lethal
Wins against: most standard openers, BM Grunt builds, AM Rifle builds
Loses to: very fast Orc harassment preventing creeping, well-timed NE Bear timing pushes

t1.goal: DK + 3-4 Fiends, creep to level 3

t2.goal: Lich second hero, add Statues for sustain, continue Fiend production

t3.goal: Orb of Corruption on DK, Destroyers if facing casters
t3.notes: Standard UD T3 for the orb — not a T3-focused build

conditionalBranches.condition: Facing mass casters (HU Priests, NE Dryads)
conditionalBranches.adjustment: Rush Destroyers for Devour Magic
Push with DK/Lich + 5 Fiends before expo pays off

replays.notes: Textbook DK opener — clean expansion timing at ~6:00, Lich transitions, dominant late game
DK into Dark Ranger variant — shows how to adapt hero choice to counter Orc summoners
DK Fiend vs NE — shows the standard Fiend/Statue composition against Night Elf expansion

builds.name: DK Fast Expand
builds.description: Death Knight opener with an early expansion to goldmine two. The gold lead funds a dominant mid-game army. Riskier than standard Fiend but snowballs hard if uncontested.
strategyPoints: Same T1 opener as standard DK Fiend — Crypt, Graveyard, Altar, Rod of Necromancy
Take expansion at 5:30-6:30 while pressuring with DK coil to deny opponent scouting
Lich second for Frost Armor on Fiends — huge survivability boost vs Orc melee
Double gold income allows faster Statue production and earlier T3
Wins against: passive opponents who don't punish the expansion window
Loses to: fast Orc push that hits before expansion defenses are up

t1.goal: DK + 2-3 Fiends, scout for expansion timing

t2.goal: Expand to second mine, Lich with Frost Armor, defend expansion

t3.goal: Orb on DK, Destroyers — funded by double gold income

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Nerubian towers at expo, pull army back to defend
Your earlier expo gives the advantage — push before they catch up

replays.notes: DK fast expand at 6:39 — mass Acolytes for double gold mining, Lich second, Destroyer transition

builds.name: DK Lich Destroyer
builds.description: DK Fiend opener that priorities a fast T3 for Destroyer tech. Destroyers' Devour Magic hard-counters caster-heavy armies like NE Dryads or HU Priests.
strategyPoints: Standard DK Fiend T1 — creep efficiently, build 4-5 Fiends before teching
Lich second with Frost Nova for burst damage in engagements
Rush T3 for Destroyers — they eat buffs/debuffs and counter caster compositions
Destroyers absorb mana for healing — self-sustaining vs magic-heavy armies
Dark Ranger third hero — Silence shuts down NE bears/dryads, Black Arrow raises skeletons
Wins against: NE Dryad/Bear compositions, HU Priest/Breaker armies
Loses to: fast timing pushes that hit before Destroyers are online

t1.goal: DK + 4-5 Fiends, creep aggressively

t2.goal: Lich second, Statues for sustain, begin T3 upgrade immediately

t3.goal: Destroyers ASAP — Devour Magic is the win condition
t3.notes: Rushed Destroyers specifically to counter caster-heavy compositions

conditionalBranches.condition: NE goes mass bears instead of casters
conditionalBranches.adjustment: Skip Destroyers, mass Fiends with Web upgrade instead
Destroyers double as anti-air, prioritize Frost Armor on them

replays.notes: Happy shows the full DK→Lich→Destroyer progression in a UD mirror — watch the Destroyer timing

builds.name: Crypt Lord Fast Fiend Push
builds.description: Crypt Lord first for Impale stun and Carrion Beetles. Fast tech to T2 with aggressive timing push at CL level 3 plus tavern hero.
strategyPoints: CL first — Impale stuns in a line, Carrion Beetles provide free meat shields
Skip DK opener entirely — CL can solo creep with beetles + Rod of Necromancy
Fast tech to T2 by 2:45, get CL to level 3 before buying tavern hero
Dark Ranger from tavern — Silence + Black Arrow combo with CL Impale is devastating
Push with CL3 + DR + 4-5 Fiends + 6 Beetles at ~7:00 timing window
Wins against: Human builds that expect standard DK opener and don't scout early
Loses to: early aggression that punishes the greedy fast tech

t1.goal: CL first, creep with beetles, fast tech to T2

t2.goal: CL level 3 + tavern hero (Dark Ranger), mass Fiends

t3.goal: Usually wins or loses before T3
t3.notes: This is a timing push build — T3 is a fallback plan, not the goal

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Transition to standard DK Fiend with expo — buy DK from tavern
Don't force it — creep to CL5 and outscale with Locust Swarm

builds.name: DK Ghoul Rush
builds.description: Aggressive DK opener into mass Ghouls. Unholy Aura speed bonus makes Ghouls extremely fast, surrounding and killing NE units before they can retreat. Dreadlord second for Vampiric Aura.
strategyPoints: DK first with Unholy Aura — the speed bonus is the core of the build
Rush Ghouls from double Crypt — quantity over quality, surround enemy units
Ghouls are cheap and expendable — trade aggressively, replace constantly
Dreadlord second for Vampiric Aura — heals Ghouls in combat, sustains pressure
Can transition to Gargoyles or Frost Wyrms at T3 if game goes late
Wins against: NE Archer builds that get surrounded, slow DH openers
Loses to: NE Mass Huntresses with Moon Glaive upgrade, well-timed Bear timing

t1.goal: DK + mass Ghouls from double Crypt, pressure NE base

t2.goal: Dreadlord second, Ghoul Frenzy upgrade, add Gargoyles

t3.goal: Frost Wyrms if game goes late — fallback air army
t3.notes: Usually decided before T3 — this is an aggro build

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Add Nerubian towers defensively, transition to Fiends with Web
Keep producing Ghouls, don't tech — ride the momentum

builds.name: BM Wind Rider
builds.description: Blademaster opener with heavy early harassment, transitioning into Wind Rider air superiority. Denies expansion and wins on economic disruption.
strategyPoints: BM's Mirror Image and Wind Walk make him nearly impossible to catch early game
Constant worker harassment forces UD to divert Acolytes and delays expansion
Wind Riders fly over Undead army positioning and attack buildings directly
Shadow Hunter second hero for Serpent Wards and Healing Wave sustain
Wins against: UD expansions that come too early or are poorly defended
Loses to: well-timed Lich Nova + DK coil that kills Wind Riders before critical mass

t1.goal: BM harass enemy base, Grunts for creeping

t2.goal: Shadow Hunter second, start Wind Rider production from Bestiary

t3.goal: Mass Wind Riders with Envenomed Weapons upgrade
t3.notes: T3 mainly for unit upgrades — army is already Wind Riders at T2

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Add Bat Riders to counter anti-air, or pivot to ground Raiders
Expand yourself and outscale — WRs can harass expansions

replays.notes: Classic Grubby BM aggression — watch the worker harassment micro and Wind Rider transition timing

builds.name: FS Expansion Wind Rider
builds.description: Far Seer opener with early expansion, scaling into a dominant Wind Rider and Bat Rider air force. Strong economic play that snowballs hard.
strategyPoints: Far Seer Spirit Wolves provide cheap harassment and goldmine pressure
Fast expansion fueled by FS Farsight scouting — always know where to expand safely
Wind Riders counter Human Sorceress Slow with Ensnare, grounding flying units
Bat Riders add oil fire splash damage that melts Human melee deathballs
Wins against: standard Human defensive AM play on open maps
Loses to: fast Human tower rushes that deny the expansion

t1.goal: FS + Grunts, harass with wolves, scout with Farsight

t2.goal: Expand, Shadow Hunter second, start Wind Rider production

t3.goal: Add Bat Riders for splash damage, double Bestiary for mass air
t3.notes: Double gold income from expansion makes mass air production viable

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Burrow defense + wolves to delay, pull WRs back to defend
Add Bat Riders — they melt Flying Machines with Unstable Concoction

replays.notes: Grubby vs Thorzain — a masterclass in FS expansion timing and Wind Rider escalation

builds.name: FS Headhunter Shaman
builds.description: Far Seer opener with Headhunters and Shamans. The most versatile Orc opener — Bloodlust makes Headhunters burst targets down, Hex and Purge shut down enemy heroes.
strategyPoints: Far Seer Spirit Wolves are free tanks that absorb Death Coil and Holy Light
Headhunters with Berserker Upgrade have extreme DPS under Bloodlust
Shaman Hex removes key enemy units from fights for several seconds
Purge removes Unholy Aura speed, Brilliance Aura, Devotion Aura
Tauren Chieftain second — Endurance Aura stacks with Bloodlust for insane attack speed
Wins against: DK openers that rely on Death Coil micro, standard AM play
Loses to: fast T2 pushes that arrive before Shamans get Bloodlust upgrade

t1.goal: FS + 2-3 Headhunters, creep with wolves tanking

t2.goal: TC second hero, Shamans for Bloodlust + Purge, continue HH production

t3.goal: Master Bloodlust upgrade, Kodo Beasts for Devour
t3.notes: T3 mainly for Shaman Master Training — the army composition stays HH/Shaman

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Headhunters already counter air — add more and skip Shamans
Add Kodo Beasts — Devour removes key enemy units permanently

replays.notes: KiWiKaKi shows the full FS Headhunter Shaman progression — see how Bloodlust timing decides fights

builds.name: BM Grunt Push
builds.description: Blademaster opener into mass Grunts for an aggressive ground push. BM harasses workers while Grunts pressure the front door. Transitions into Spirit Walkers or Raiders at T2.
strategyPoints: BM Wind Walk into enemy base for worker kills while Grunts creep
Mass Grunts are cost-effective and trade well in melee engagements
Shadow Hunter second — Healing Wave keeps Grunts alive in sustained fights
Push timing at 50-60 food with BM3 + SH + 5-6 Grunts
Wins against: greedy NE fast expansions, NE Archer openers without Huntresses
Loses to: well-positioned Ancient Protectors, NE mass Huntress with Moon Glaive

t1.goal: BM + 4-5 Grunts, harass with BM while Grunts creep

t2.goal: SH second, Spirit Walkers for Disenchant, Raiders for Ensnare

t3.goal: Taurens if game goes late — Pulverize is devastating in melee
t3.notes: Usually decided at T2 timing push — T3 is the fallback

conditionalBranches.condition: NE builds Ancient Protectors at expansion
conditionalBranches.adjustment: Don't force it — take your own expansion and outscale
Add Headhunters or transition to Wind Riders

replays.notes: Cash BM Grunt push into Spirit Walker transition — shows the T2 tech path against NE

builds.name: FS Fast Tech
builds.description: Far Seer fast tech build that skips Barracks entirely to rush Stronghold. FS harasses constantly while base techs. Fastest T2 timing of any Orc build.
strategyPoints: No Barracks — saves lumber for faster Stronghold, but no T1 army units
FS solo creeps with Spirit Wolves as tanks — efficient mana usage is critical
Chain Lightning harasses HU hero + army from range — kite and poke
Stronghold arrives 30-45s before standard builds — surprise T2 timing advantage
Shadow Hunter second from Altar as soon as Stronghold completes
Wins against: Human players who expect standard opener and play passively
Loses to: aggressive HU AM push that punishes the lack of T1 units

t1.goal: FS only — no combat units, just tech to Stronghold ASAP

t2.goal: Fastest possible T2 — Bestiary for Wind Riders, Spirit Lodge for Shamans

t3.goal: Mass Wind Riders + Bat Riders — the payoff for the greedy fast tech

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Build emergency Barracks + Burrow defense, delay with wolves
Punish with early WR harassment on workers and supply buildings

builds.name: AM Rifle Caster
builds.description: The standard Human build. Archmage with Water Elementals into Riflemen, then Priests and Spell Breakers at T2. Works in every matchup with adjustments.
strategyPoints: Archmage Water Elementals are free units that trade well early — micro them aggressively
Brilliance Aura gives permanent mana regen to all nearby units — enables Blizzard spam
Riflemen have the longest range of any T1 ground unit — kite melee effectively
Mountain King second for Storm Bolt stun and Bash — shuts down enemy hero plays
Priests with Inner Fire buff Riflemen damage, Heal sustains the army between fights
Spell Breakers at T2 — Control Magic steals summons, Spell Immunity blocks nukes
Wins against: most standard openers, NE Archer builds, Orc Grunt builds
Loses to: mass Mountain Giants with Taunt, UD Destroyer transitions

t1.goal: AM + Footmen for creeping, transition to Rifles

t2.goal: MK second hero, Arcane Sanctum for Priests + Spell Breakers

t3.goal: Castle for Knight production and Master Training upgrades
t3.notes: T3 is optional — many games end at T2 with Rifle/Caster army

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Add Flying Machines from Workshop, Riflemen already counter air
More Spell Breakers with Control Magic — steal their summons

replays.notes: Cash shows the AM Rifle opening — notice hero positioning and how Water Elementals buy space

builds.name: AM Dragonhawk Riders
builds.description: Archmage opener scaling into Dragonhawk Rider air superiority. Cloud and Aerial Shackles control the battlefield while Dragonhawks deal sustained damage.
strategyPoints: Archmage Brilliance Aura gives permanent mana regen — spam Blizzard all game
Sorceress Slow shuts down Orc Grunt melee even with Bloodlust active
Dragonhawks' Cloud disables enemy buildings — shuts down production during pushes
Aerial Shackles lock down enemy air units, preventing escape
Mountain King second for Storm Bolt — stun Chain Lightning combo is devastating
Wins against: Orc armies that lack anti-air (no Bat Riders or Headhunters)
Loses to: Orc Fast Wind Rider with Ensnare — grounds your entire army at once

t1.goal: AM + Footmen for creeping, fast tech to Keep

t2.goal: MK second, Gryphon Aviary for Dragonhawk production

t3.goal: Mass Dragonhawks, add Gryphon Riders for damage
t3.notes: T3 unlocks Gryphon Riders — devastating combined with Dragonhawks

conditionalBranches.condition: Orc builds Headhunters or Bat Riders
conditionalBranches.adjustment: Add Sorceresses for Slow, Priests for healing — support the air army
Cloud the expansion buildings — shut down production while you push

replays.notes: Thorzain's AM into Dragonhawk build — even in a loss the build order execution is textbook

builds.name: MK Fast Expand
builds.description: Mountain King first into fast expansion. Storm Bolt stuns harassers, Bash provides melee dominance. Build army to 60 food then upgrade to Castle for Knights.
strategyPoints: MK first — Storm Bolt is the best anti-harass stun in the game
Fast expansion with militia to defend the new Town Hall
MK + Footmen + Rifles can defend expo against most early aggression
AM second for Brilliance Aura mana sustain and Water Elementals
Build to 60 food on two bases, then tech to Castle for Knights
Paladin third hero for Holy Light healing and Divine Shield safety
Wins against: opponents who don't punish the expansion window
Loses to: fast timing attacks that hit before the expansion pays off

t1.goal: MK + Footmen, scout for expansion timing

t2.goal: Expand, AM second, Rifles + Priests for army sustain

t3.goal: Knights with double gold income — the payoff for expanding
t3.notes: Castle timing is faster with double gold — that's the whole point

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Militia + Scout Towers to defend, pull MK back
Your MK is better in defensive fights — just outscale

builds.name: Paladin Rifle
builds.description: Paladin first with Riflemen as primary army. Holy Light keeps expensive Rifles alive, Divine Shield at level 6 is a panic button. Sustain-focused build that wins through attrition.
strategyPoints: Paladin first — Holy Light is the strongest single-target heal in the game
Rifles live longer with Paladin healing — more value per gold spent
Divine Shield at level 6 — panic button that saves Paladin from any burst
AM second for Brilliance Aura — enables constant Blizzard + Holy Light spam
Priests add Inner Fire buff and additional healing — double sustain layer
Wins against: Orc builds relying on focus fire to trade heroes
Loses to: mana drain (NE DH Manaburn), Undead Destroyers (Devour Magic)

t1.goal: Paladin + Footmen, transition to Rifles immediately

t2.goal: AM second, Priests for double healing, Inner Fire on Rifles

t3.goal: Gryphon Riders for late-game air damage
t3.notes: T3 Gryphons are the payoff — strong with Paladin sustain keeping them alive

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Play defensive until Divine Shield — then push aggressively
Keep Paladin at range, use Scroll of Replenishment, prioritize level 6

builds.name: KotG Mountain Giant
builds.description: Keeper of the Grove opener into Mountain Giant tank line. Entangle roots Human heroes, Giants taunt Human armies, and Treant summons provide free reinforcements.
strategyPoints: KotG Entangling Roots roots Human heroes — removes Divine Shield timing windows
Mountain Giants have the highest HP of any unit in the game at Tier 3
Giant Taunt forces Human Sorceresses to polymorph their own units if poorly positioned
Force of Nature summons free Treants from enemy trees — punishes Human passive play
DH second hero for Manaburn — drains AM/MK mana, shuts down their abilities
Wins against: Human AM Rifle builds that rely on kiting, not tanking hits
Loses to: Archmage Blizzard with Mass Teleport that kills Giants before Taunt activates

t1.goal: KotG + Archers, creep with Entangle for free kills

t2.goal: Tree of Ages, Ancient of Lore for Dryads, tech to T3 for Giants

t3.goal: Mountain Giants with Hardened Skin — the army anchor
t3.notes: Giants are the entire build's purpose — everything else supports them

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Defend with Dryads + Archers, delay until Giants are online
Add Hippogryph Riders — Giants can't hit air, you need anti-air

replays.notes: Foggy shows the KotG Mountain Giant build — the build order timing and giant production queue is the key lesson here

builds.name: DH Fast Bear Tech
builds.description: The standard Night Elf build. Demon Hunter first for Manaburn harassment, fast tech to T3 for Druid of the Claw (bears). Bears in Bear Form have massive HP and Roar aura.
strategyPoints: DH first — Manaburn drains enemy hero mana, shutting down their abilities
Immolation provides passive AoE damage — good for fast creeping
Fast tech through T2 to T3 — the goal is Bears as fast as possible
Druids of the Claw in Bear Form have 960 HP and Roar gives 25% damage aura
KotG second hero for Entangle + Treants — lockdown and free reinforcements
Dryads provide Abolish Magic to remove debuffs and Slow Poison for kiting
Wins against: most standard openers across all matchups
Loses to: fast timing pushes that hit during the vulnerable T2 transition

t1.goal: DH + 3-4 Archers, creep aggressively with Immolation

t2.goal: Tree of Ages, Ancient of Lore x2, Dryads while teching to T3

t3.goal: Master Bears — Bear Form with Roar and Rejuvenation
t3.notes: Bears are arguably the best T3 unit in the game — the entire build leads here

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Keep Dryads to bait Devour Magic, then re-buff Bears
Manaburn the BM — he can't harass without mana for Wind Walk

builds.name: KotG Fast Expand
builds.description: Keeper of the Grove with fast expansion into Huntress map control. Entangle roots enemy heroes and creeps for safe expansion. Huntresses provide aggressive map presence.
strategyPoints: KotG first for Entangling Roots — roots give free creep kills and hero lockdown
Fast expansion at 3:00-4:00 — KotG Treants provide free defense at the expansion
Huntresses with Moon Glaive upgrade bounce attacks between clumped enemies
Ancient Protectors at expansion for defense — they uproot to reposition
DH second hero for Manaburn — drains enemy hero mana during engagements
Wins against: Orc players who don't scout and pressure the expansion
Loses to: fast BM harassment that kills wisps before expansion completes

t1.goal: KotG + Archers, transition to Huntresses, scout for expansion

t2.goal: Expand, Ancient Protectors for defense, DH second hero

t3.goal: Bears + Dryads funded by double gold income
t3.notes: The expansion makes T3 Bears affordable faster

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Uproot Protectors to block, Entangle key units, delay until army arrives
Your earlier expo gives advantage — push before they catch up

replays.notes: Foggy KotG expansion into Huntresses with Ancient Protector defense vs ORC BM Grunt push

builds.name: PotM Mass Huntress
builds.description: Priestess of the Moon first with Trueshot Aura boosting Huntress DPS. Mass Huntresses provide aggressive map control and deny Human expansion. Searing Arrows steal creep kills.
strategyPoints: PotM first — Trueshot Aura gives all ranged units bonus damage passively
Searing Arrows let PotM last-hit creeps from enemy — denies XP and items
Mass Huntresses with Moon Glaive — bouncing attacks shred clumped units
Huntresses are fast and can raid enemy lumber line, pressure expansions
Shadowmeld keeps PotM safe — hide and ambush when enemy hero walks past
DH second for Manaburn — removes enemy hero's ability to cast spells
Wins against: Human AM Rifle builds without early anti-Huntress tech
Loses to: mass AoE (Blizzard, Thunder Clap) that shreds low-HP Huntresses

t1.goal: PotM + Archers, transition to mass Huntresses with Moon Glaive

t2.goal: DH second, Huntresses for map pressure, Dryads for utility

t3.goal: Bears as late-game transition if Huntress pressure stalls
t3.notes: Games are often decided at T1/T2 — this is a pressure build, not a T3 build

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Don't force — expand yourself and transition to Bears at T3
Spread Huntresses, don't clump — Moon Glaive works in spread formations

builds.name: DH Mass Talons
builds.description: Demon Hunter into mass Druids of the Talon with Cyclone spam. Exploits Orc's limited dispel options. Cyclone removes key units from fights, Faerie Fire reduces armor.
strategyPoints: DH first for Manaburn — drains Blademaster's mana, preventing Wind Walk escapes
Druids of the Talon cast Cyclone — removes Grunts and key units from fights for 6 seconds
Mass Cyclone means Orc can never fight at full strength — always 2-3 units disabled
Faerie Fire reduces armor and reveals invisible units — BM can't hide
Beastmaster from tavern for Quilbeast summons and Stampede ultimate
Orc Spirit Walkers can Ethereal Form to avoid Cyclone — but NE can just focus other units
Wins against: Orc melee compositions without heavy dispel
Loses to: FS Headhunter builds that outrange Talons, mass Spirit Walkers

t1.goal: DH + Archers, creep to DH level 3 for Evasion

t2.goal: Ancient of Wind for Druid of the Talon production, start massing Talons

t3.goal: Double Ancient of Wind, Master Talon upgrade for Storm Crow Form
t3.notes: Storm Crow Form lets Talons fly — attack and Cyclone from the air

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Mix in Dryads for Abolish Magic, focus fire Spirit Walkers first
Add Mountain Giants — Taunt forces Headhunters into melee range

builds.name: DH Mass Huntress
builds.description: Demon Hunter opener into fast Huntress production. Huntresses provide early map control and pressure while DH burns enemy hero mana. Transitions to bears at T3.
strategyPoints: DH first for Manaburn — shuts down enemy hero casting immediately
1 Ancient of War into fast Huntress Hall — Huntresses come online quickly
Sentinel upgrade gives vision across the map — no more hidden expansions or creep routes
Moon Glaive upgrade — bouncing attacks make Huntresses devastating vs clumped units
KotG second for Entangle root and Treant summons — supports Huntress aggression
Wins against: builds that rely on hero abilities (AM, FS, DK)
Loses to: massed ranged units that kite Huntresses (Rifles, Fiends with Web)

t1.goal: DH + Archers, fast Huntress Hall, transition to Huntresses

t2.goal: KotG second, Huntress pressure, Dryads for utility/anti-magic

t3.goal: Bears for late-game transition if needed
t3.notes: Most games decided before T3 — Huntresses are the core army

conditionalBranches.adjustment: Mix in Archers to trade at range, don't force melee engagements
Add Glaive Throwers for siege, maintain map control with Sentinels
